osmOverlay.source: OpenStreetMap address objects via Geofabrik Sweden extract
osmOverlay.method: Mean center of OSM nodes/ways carrying addr:postcode for each five-digit Swedish postcode.

meta.method: One point per 5-digit postcode. When GeoNames has multiple rows for a code, rows with the highest accuracy are retained and their coordinates are averaged. When an OpenStreetMap address-centroid overlay is available, it replaces the GeoNames point for that postcode.
